caption:
Brownie Cookie
Desserts from A-Z, the goal : to try to make desserts i have never made before. the key word here is try with C for Cookie. i really wanted to make a cookie i havent shown before and this cookie combines my favorite two desserts - a brownie and a cookie! fudgy, the perfect crinkle top and takes under 30 minutes to make

Ingredients:
-50 grams butter
-100 grams chocolate 
-10 grams cocoa powder
-1/2 tsp coffee powder
-1 whole egg + 1 yolk ( use the extra white for breakfast)
-110 grams sugar 
-2 tsp canola oil
-1/2 tsp vanilla extract
-75 grams maida
-1/2 tsp baking powder
-pinch of salt + sea salt to top your baked cookies
-add as many or as little chocolate chips you want 

Method:
-melt butter and chocolate in a microwave, add in cocoa + coffee powder
-in another bowl, beat together the eggs + sugar + oil + vanilla till light and frothy
-add in your chocolate mix to the egg mix, fold gently and combine
-sift in the maida + baking powder + salt
-spoon your cookie mix onto a parchment lined baking sheet, you can do any size you want, tiny, medium or large like shown here. ensure you keep a decent amount of space between the cookies as THEY WILL SPREAD
-bake for 190 degrees for 6-10 minutes depending on the size of your cookie
